notes: of the Father is added under rule 5: no source token in the verse expresses it, and rule 103 keeps rule 7 from folding a full lexical noun phrase onto a neighbouring token. The ASV's italics corroborate rather than license this.
s004 heads on pleasure under rule 66, the noun glossing the eudok- lexeme while it was the good are supplied.
that (t010) goes to the infinitive under rule 85; rule 74's aside is scoped to a supplied subject and does not decide a complementizer's placement.
